QuestInfo.name: Good Vibrations
QuestInfo.1: Take out the #b#o3230400##k near #bEos Tower 70th Floor# and collect #b40 #t04000127##k for #b#p2040008##k on #r#m221021800##k.
QuestInfo.2: Is it really possible to communicate with drums?

0.0: Do you remember me? I'm #b#p2040007##k. I know, we all look alike, so you might not remember me. Look, #bI could really use your help#k. Can you spare the time?
0.1: We have a little #bcommunication problem#k. Working across the tower means we have a hard time tracking each other down to pass on a message. I was hoping you could help me figure out how to talk to my brothers without having to leave my post.
0.2: So, unless you want to work as our full-time messenger, maybe you could bring me #b40 #t04000127#s#k from the #b#o3230400##k creatures in Eos Tower?\nI think we might be able to set up some sort of percussive relay system...

yes.0: I'll leave you to it. While you're out there, can you clear out some of those #b#o3230400##k monsters? I don't want our signals getting crossed... Oh, and you can bring those #b40 #t04000127#s#k to #b#p2040008##k in #r#m221021800##k.

1.0: Did you come here on behalf of #b#p2040008##k? How'd it go? \nI'll take the #b40 #t04000127#s#k items you got...

yes.0: This is going to make our work so much better!\r\nEverybody wins when we can talk to each other!

npc.0: Get #b40 #t04000127#s#k and give them to #b#p2040008##k in #r#m221021800##k.

item.0: There are a ton of #b#o3230400##k monsters nearby. If you bring me #b40 #t04000127#s#k items, we can set up our communication system!
